response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished software developer with 20 years of experience, but he is fundamentally mismatched for this role. He has only approximately 6 months of documented C++ experience (2014-2015), far short of the mandatory 5-10 years, and C++ is not even listed in his current skills summary. He lacks any Windows platform development background, has limited SQL experience (MySQL and basic SQL, not SQL Server/Oracle), and most critically, has no fixed income, capital markets, investment banking, or capital banking domain expertise. His career has been entirely focused on web development, mobile applications, and scripting languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js).
strengths: Extensive 20-year track record as a professional software developer with demonstrated ability to master diverse technology stacks and solve complex problems
Excellent communication and teaching abilities, evidenced by multiple conference talks, workshops, and successful mentoring initiatives across organizations
Solid CI/CD and DevOps infrastructure knowledge with practical experience in GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, and deployment automation
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience (2014-2015), not the mandatory 5-10 years; C++ is notably absent from listed skills despite being the core requirement
No demonstrated Windows platform development experience; entire career focused on web, mobile, and Linux-based systems rather than systems-level programming
Complete absence of financial services domain expertise, particularly in fixed income, capital markets, investment banking, or capital banking
